privateDaemonMeasurement.method: Committed clean worktree; private daemon on port 0 and disposable state directory; HTTP requests counted UTF-8 response bytes. Tailnet request set the exact Host header. The daemon was SIGTERM-closed after measurement; no live listener or port 7478 was touched.
